//! An inner doc comment. //// four slashes is an ordinary comment again /// An outer doc comment. // a plain line comment /**/ /*** a plain block /* nested */ still plain ***/ /** a doc block /* nested plain is still doc */ */ #![allow(dead_code)] #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)] pub struct Buffer<T> { items: Vec<T>, len: usize, } const MAX: u32 = 1_000; static GREETING: &str = "hello \"world\"\n"; macro_rules! twice { ($x:expr) => { $x + $x }; } impl<T: Clone> Buffer<T> { pub fn new() -> Self { Buffer { items: Vec::new(), len: 0 } } pub async fn push(&mut self, item: T) -> Result<(), String> { self.items.push(item); self.len += 1; Ok(()) } fn numbers(&self) { // non-ASCII identifiers, so the XID substitution is measured let café = 1; let Ωmega = 2; let _ = (café, Ωmega); let a = 42; let b = 42u8; let c = 0xdead_beef; let d = 0b1010_1010i64; let e = 0o755; let f = 1_000.5; let g = 1.5e-3f64; let h = 2.; let _ = (a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h); } fn strings(&self) { let s = "escaped \t \u{1F600} \x41"; let r = r#"raw "quotes" and \no escapes"#; let b = b"bytes"; let ch = 'x'; let nl = '\n'; let _ = (s, r, b, ch, nl); } } pub trait Shape { fn area(&self) -> f64; } fn main() { let mut buf = Buffer::<i32>::new(); println!("{:?} {}", buf, twice!(3)); let v = vec![1, 2, 3]; for x in v.iter() { match x { 1 => println!("one"), _ => (), } } let opt: Option<&i32> = v.first(); if let Some(n) = opt { let _ = n.to_string(); } let lt: &'static str = GREETING; let _ = (lt, MAX, buf.len); }
